body:
Join us for the HCP October Refresher Webinar Thursday October 15 th at 1pm Eastern. You'll learn how your training can reflect both your policies & procedures And your organization's unique compliance culture! You're invited to join us Thursday October 15th at 1pm Eastern for our monthly refresher training webinar. Join us to learn about customization of your training including:

  • development of new slides,
  • editing policies and procedures,
  • applying your compliance culture to the training
  • uploading pictures, video
  • and narration of slides.

Join the screen-sharing meeting:

  • https://join.me/HCP-Support
